source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-probe-cap-three-inventory-overflow-renders-bare.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: The inventory probe_cap is a CORRECTNESS value, not a tuning value: the row grain is warehouse x system-location (measured 13 rows for ONE stocked candidate), so past three candidates the backend's default limit of 50 saturates and truncation is structurally undetectable. Two missed tokens carrying two candidates each is four; the fourth must land in dym_capped_codes and be absent from dym_candidate_codes, so it renders BARE downstream — the cap can withhold an annotation but must never invent one.
